video_title: Evaluating OG Anunoby's tip-in game-winner 🔥 'HE'S BUILT FOR THESE MOMENTS!' - Chiney Ogwumike | SC

quotes.speaker: OG Anunoby
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby on his game-winning tip-in against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: It feels cool. Everyone's pretty excited. I'm excited too. We're all excited.
quotes.quote: It feels cool. Everyone's pretty excited. I'm excited too. We're all excited. We're enjoying it right now, but we're just focused on the next game now.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown calls Anunoby's tip-in the most iconic shot in Knicks history
quotes.excerpt: That has to be the most iconic shot in the history of New York basketball.
quotes.quote: It's unbelievable. The tip, how he had to control it and tip it in from, I mean, like I said, that has to be the most iconic shot in the history of New York basketball. I'm not you guys, you guys know better than me, but it was just unbelievable.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart credits OG Anunoby for saving him from regret
quotes.excerpt: I got a special shout-out for OG, man, because he saved me from a lifetime of regret.
quotes.quote: I got a special shout-out for OG, man, because he saved me from a lifetime of regret. So yeah, man, shout-out to him.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the Spurs' fourth-quarter collapse
quotes.excerpt: We clearly weren't the most hungry in the second half.
quotes.quote: I think it began before the third quarter. I can't really explain it right now. I don't know. I think it's just execution, greediness of some sort. We clearly weren't the most hungry in the second half.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on his reaction to the Knicks' comeback
quotes.excerpt: I literally prayed. I was that scared to watch the last play.
quotes.quote: I was watching and blinking, and I was keeping my head down, and I was just saying, 'Good Lord, please don't do this to me.' We come back this far, and then they missed a shot, but Anunoby put it back in. I literally prayed. I was that scared to watch the last play, but they ended up holding on, coming back from a 29-point deficit.

quotes.speaker: Michael Wilson
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Wilson calls the Spurs' loss the biggest choke job in sports history
quotes.excerpt: This tonight is the biggest choke job I've seen at a championship level in any sport.
quotes.quote: I'm trying to be careful here because I'm talking about the Spurs, who I have so much respect for the people who lorded over this organization, who defined the organization: Greg Popovich, Tim Duncan, and David Robinson. This tonight is the biggest choke job I've seen at a championship level in any sport at any time.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike and Aminah discuss the Knicks' resilience
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks showed what we've seen from them all season long: resilience.

text_blocks.speaker: Aminah
text_blocks.text: The Knicks showed what we've seen from them all season long: resilience. Down 29 and still getting it done. How did the Knicks flip the script in Game 4?

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: They were able to pull off a miracle in Madison Square Garden because they don't care what anybody thinks. They go out there and they play their style, starting with, of course, OG Anunoby.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike on OG Anunoby's professional poise
quotes.excerpt: He's the type of guy that just feels like he's built for these moments.
quotes.quote: This man has been rock steady the entire NBA Finals, and he's the type of guy that just feels like he's built for these moments. He's built for the grit, he's built for the grind. OG Anunoby, I know everyone wants to talk about the tip-in. Can we talk about the three? That was a living, you're living right three that touched every aspect of the rim before it went down.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike on the Spurs' mental collapse
quotes.excerpt: This one is a mental backbreaker.
quotes.quote: This one is a mental backbreaker. It's a mental backbreaker to be up 29 and then to choose to settle time and time again for threes, to have Victor Wembanyama on the floor for the entire second half knowing that he's tired. This is a squad that is young, and it's tough to watch because their experienced guy that they brought in, De'Aaron Fox, made a tough mistake as well.
